messages.author: cb4406215dc6a38c
messages.subject: Height of plot title
parts:
Hi,

Is there a way I can find out the height of the title on a plot?  My reason for asking is that I need to be specific about the height and width of my plot (it’s a map so the proportions have to be right), and I can’t use coord_equal() because I’m using zooming limits (i.e. coord_cartesian(xlim=c(3,4)), not the regular limits (which were cutting some of the outer polygons that I need to see).  

 

I’m not very familiar with Grid, but I imagine I could get the height of the [title] viewport somehow?

 

Cheers,

Mark

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Height of plot title
parts:
You should need to know the height of the title - just set the aspect
ratio of the plot (e.g. opts(aspect.ratio = 1)) to the correct value
for your map.

Hadley
